comment: Shared HKDF vectors: the plugin (ServerKeysTest) and the server (keys.test.ts) must both reproduce these. groupId = base32(HKDF-SHA256(ikm = the key's 16 bytes, salt = none, info = 'gimu/v1/id', 16 bytes)), lower case, no padding; groupAuth = base64url(HKDF(ikm, info = 'gimu/v1/auth', 32 bytes)), no padding. Generated with node:crypto by server/scripts/vectors.ts.
